dates_and_calendars.holidays

Gets the holidays between the start date and the end date using one or many calendars.

Available as lseg.data.dates_and_calendars.holidays.

holidays(
    start_date: OptDateTime = None,
    end_date: OptDateTime = None,
    calendars: list[str] | None = None,
    currencies: list[str] | None = None,
) -> HolidaysResponse

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
start_date OptDateTime No None Calculation start date.
end_date OptDateTime No None Calculation end date.
calendars list[str] | None No None Calendars to determine the working days and national holidays for particular countries. Optional if currencies is provided.
currencies list[str] | None No None Currencies to use for calculation of the date for the working day or weekend. Optional if calendars is provided.

Returns

HolidaysResponse

HolidaysResponse object with dataframe, requested calendars and offset

Example

import datetime
import lseg.data as ld

ld.open_session("platform.default")

holidays_response = ld.dates_and_calendars.holidays(
   start_date=datetime.datetime(2019, 11, 20),
   end_date=datetime.datetime(2020, 2, 20),
   calendars=["EMU", "GER"],
)
